# Build rotated/padded output in portrait column-major order, using the components above.
# Components include pixel coordinates from the earlier flood fill.
# Sort by source lane (left-to-right), then top-to-bottom within each lane.
comps_col = sorted(comps, key=lambda q:(q[1],q[0]))
rotated=[]
for top,left,bottom,right,cells in comps_col:
    crop=[[grid[r][col] for col in range(left,right+1)] for r in range(top,bottom+1)]
    H=len(crop); W=len(crop[0])
    rot=[[crop[r][W-1-i] for r in range(H)] for i in range(W)]  # CCW
    rotated.append((top,left,H,W,rot))
maxw=max(len(row) for _,_,_,_,obj in rotated for row in obj)
out=[]
for top,left,H,W,obj in rotated:
    pad=(maxw-len(obj[0]))//2
    out += [[8]*pad + row + [8]*(maxw-len(row)-pad) for row in obj]
[(top,left,H,W,obj) for top,left,H,W,obj in rotated],maxw,out,len(out)
